name: plain
style: Hand-drawn illustration, flat shapes, soft limited palette, quiet and clean. No 3D render, no CGI.
character: a composed adult person, seen from far away, at their desk
layout: Extreme long shot. The person occupies only the bottom-right corner, about 15% of the frame. The other 85% stays open and uncluttered for desktop icons.
motion: Locked-off camera, one continuous take, no cuts. The frame you are given is the picture: her pose, what she is holding and the light are already decided. The clip is played behind the desktop icons over and over without a break, so it has to come back to where it started: same pose, same place, same light, the last frame as close to the first as you can make it, and the join invisible. Only the smallest motion, the kind you notice a second late: she breathes, blinks once, her weight settles by a hair; a few strands of her hair and the loose knit of her top drift in the slowest breeze; outside, water crawls down the glass. No action of any kind: she does not sit down or get up, turn, cross or uncross her legs, lift, reach for or pick anything up. Nothing on the desk moves from where it is, her hands stay where they are, whatever she is holding stays square to the camera exactly where it is, and the characters written on any paper stay the same, sharp and still. Nothing appears that was not in the first frame, nothing leaves, and nothing comes round on a beat: no rocking, no swaying back and forth, no gesture that starts over while the clip plays.
hold: The camera does not move and the framing never changes. She stays the same size, in the same place, in the same drawing as the source frame, and the open area stays open from the first frame to the last. The light does not change either: the same exposure, brightness, contrast, colour and shadows as the source frame, no flicker, no fade, no sun moving and no slow brightening or darkening anywhere in the clip, so an hour of looping never makes the desktop pulse.

scenes.desc: a bright morning through a large window, low sun across the floor
rain running down the glass, everything outside soft and grey
a city at night far below, small lights, quiet
low hills fading into haze, nothing urgent out there

room: Kept things stand on a shelf, on the windowsill, or on the wall.
note_layout: Long shot for the room, but the note is a foreground object: she holds it out toward the camera at full arm length, square to the camera, so it reads large and sharp in the bottom-right of the frame. Everything left of centre and everything above her stays open and uncluttered for desktop icons.
idle: standing at the window, doing nothing in particular
